topic: Organizing a School Carpool with Another Parent

script.title: SCHOOL CARPOOL
script.story_hook: Two parents, one pickup line, one better idea.
script.intro_zh: 兩位家長、一條接送隊伍，和一個更好的主意。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the after school pickup line. Listen for friendly arrangement words.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到放學後的接送隊伍。留意友好的商量說法。
script.outro: And that's one carpool all agreed. Try the tricky lines once more.
script.outro_zh: 一個共乘就這樣約好了。再把難句多唸一次。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: an upbeat mom in her early forties with long dark hair in a loose braid over one shoulder, oversized hoop earrings, a cream knit sweater, straight-leg jeans, and a curvy build
script.char_b_description: a laid-back dad in his late thirties with a shaved head, black rectangular glasses, a heather grey quarter zip, navy chinos, clean white sneakers, and a solid build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! You're Leo's dad, right? I'm Dana.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ jɚz ˈlioʊz dæd raɪt aɪm ˈdanə/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，你是里歐的爸爸對吧？我是黛娜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's me! You must be Mia's mom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts mi ju mʌz bi ˈmiəz mɑm/
dialogue.zh: 就是我！你一定是米雅的媽媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guilty. Can I ask something a little weird?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɪlti kən aɪ æsk ˈsʌmθɪŋ ə ˈlɪɾəl wɪɹd/
dialogue.zh: 讓你猜到啦。我能不能問一個有點怪的問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what's up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wɑts ˈʌp/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you ever want to share a carpool?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju ˈɛvɚ wɑnt tə ʃɛr ə ˈkɑɹˌpul/
dialogue.zh: 你願不願意跟我們輪流共乘接送？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly, I've been thinking the same thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli aɪv bɪn ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ðə seɪm θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我也一直在想同一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, the pickup line is brutal every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ðə ˈpɪkˌʌp laɪn ɪz ˈbɹutəl ˈɛvɹi deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，每天那條接送隊伍可怕死了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me about it, it takes us forty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ɪt ɪt teɪks ʌs ˈfɔɹti ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 別提了，我們每次要四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, mine too, plus the circling cars.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪn tu plʌz ðə ˈsɝklɪŋ kɑɹz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我也是，加上那些繞來繞去的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, how would we split the days?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ wʊd wi ˈsplɪt ðə ˈdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那，我們要怎麼分日子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I was thinking I take Monday and Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wəz ˈθɪŋkɪŋ aɪ teɪk ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ænd ˈtuzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我想由我負責星期一和星期二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'd do Wednesday and Thursday, sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ d du ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ ænd ˈθɝzdeɪ ʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那我來負責星期三和星期四，好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday, we could alternate week by week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹaɪˌdeɪ wi kʊd ɔlˈtɝnət wik baɪ wik/
dialogue.zh: 星期五我們可以一週一輪流。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That works, Friday's the worst traffic anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɝks ˈfɹaɪˌdeɪz ðə wɝst ˈtɹæfɪk ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那樣可以，星期五的車陣本來就最糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, so I'd pick them up at three fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ soʊ aɪ d pɪk ðɛm ʌp æt θɹi ˈfɪftɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我三點十五去接他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same for me, the bell rings at three.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm fɚ mi ðə bɛl ɹɪŋz æt ˈθɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我也一樣，下課鐘三點響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, do you have a car seat for Mia?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ du ju hæv ə kɑɹ sit fɚ ˈmiə/
dialogue.zh: 對了，你有幫米雅準備安全座椅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, she's booster seat age now, luckily.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ʃiz ˈbuːstɚ sit eɪdʒ naʊ ˈlʌkəli/
dialogue.zh: 還好，她已經改用增高坐墊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same with Leo. So no heavy installs.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm wɪð ˈlioʊ soʊ noʊ ˈhɛvɪ ɪnˈstɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 里歐也是，所以不用裝那種重座椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One less headache, I'll take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn lɛs ˈhɛdˌeɪk aɪl teɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 少一個麻煩，求之不得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the awkward part, gas money.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ði ˈɔkwɚd pɑɹt ɡæz ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 現在是難堪的部分，油錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I knew there'd be a money part.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ nud ðɛɹd bi ə ˈmʌni pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我就知道會談到錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we just split it every Sunday night?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi dʒʌst splɪt ɪt ˈɛvɹi ˈsʌnˌdeɪ naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以每週日晚上把錢分一分嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll send my half through the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ aɪl sɛnd maɪ hæf θɹu ði ˈæp/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我那一份我會用 App 轉過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, no more chasing twenty dollar bills.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt noʊ mɔɹ ˈtʃeɪsɪŋ ˈtwɛnti ˈdɑlə bɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，不用再追那幾張二十塊的鈔票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, agreed. What if someone runs late?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ əˈɡrid wʌt ɪf ˈsʌmˌwʌn ɹʌnz leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，說定了。如果有人遲了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need a grace window, um, ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid ə ɡɹeɪs ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ʌm tɛn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 我們需要一個緩衝時間，嗯，十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten sounds fair, we won't honk in a panic.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈsaʊndz fɛɹ wi woʊnt hɑŋk ɪn ə ˈpænɪk/
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘很合理，我們不會慌張按喇叭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, and if it's more than twenty?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ænd ɪf ɪts mɔɹ ðæn ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 對，如果超過二十分鐘呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you call ahead, no one waits around.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju kɔl əˈhɛd noʊ wʌn weɪts əˈɹaʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 那你提前打電話來，沒有人會乾等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good rule, kids get cranky in the lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ɹul kɪdz ɡɛt ˈkɹæŋki ɪn ðə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 好規則，小孩在停車場很容易鬧脾氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very true. What's the backup plan though?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛɹi tɹu wʌts ðə ˈbækˌʌp plæn ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太對了。那備援計畫是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I'm sick, my sister can cover a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf aɪm sɪk maɪ ˈsɪstɚ kən kəˈvɚ ə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 如果我生病，我姊可以代開一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, and if I'm out of town?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ænd ɪf aɪm ɑʊt əv ˈtaʊn/
dialogue.zh: 不錯，那如果我要出城呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We tell each other a day before, that's all.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tɛl itʃ ˈʌðɚ ə deɪ bɪˈfɔɹ ðæts ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我們互相提前一天說一聲就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, no last minute surprises then.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ noʊ læst ˈmɪnət səɹˈpɹaɪzɪz ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 合理，沒有臨時的意外了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. If all else fails, a rideshare?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɪf ˈɔl ɛls feɪlz ə ˈɹaɪdˌʃɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 就是說，如果全都行不通，就叫網約車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for emergencies, and we split that cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli fɚ ɪˈmɝdʒənsiz ænd wi splɪt ðæt kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 只在緊急時，然後那筆錢我們對半分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Agreed, I'd rather not, but good to know.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid aɪd ˈɹɑðɚ nɑt bʌt ɡʊd tə noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 同意，我寧可別用上，但有備無患。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here. Do the kids need snacks?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm hɪɹ du ðə ˈkɪdz nid ˈsnæks/
dialogue.zh: 我也一樣。小孩需要點心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, maybe just water, no messy food.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈmeɪbi dʒʌst ˈwɔɾɚ noʊ ˈmɛsi fud/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，也許只有水就好，別帶會弄髒的食物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, my car is my baby, I'm kidding.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt maɪ kɑɹ ɪz maɪ ˈbeɪbi aɪm ˈkɪdɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的車是我的寶貝，我開玩笑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, mine too, no juice in the back seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪn tu noʊ dʒus ɪn ðə ˈbæk ˈsɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我也是，後座不放果汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, when do we start this Monday thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛn du wi stɑɹt ðɪs ˈmʌnˌdeɪ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那，這個週一的安排什麼時候開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How about next Monday? Leaves us a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt nɛkst ˈmʌnˌdeɪ livz ʌs ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 下週一如何？還有一週可以準備。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds good, I'll text you my schedule.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡʊd aɪl tɛkst ju maɪ ˈskɛdʒuəl/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很好，我會用訊息把我的時間表傳過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll send a shared calendar too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛnd ə ʃɛɹd ˈkæləndɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 我也會傳一份共用的行事曆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is this carpool one way or both ways?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ˈkɑɹˌpul ˈwʌn weɪ ɔɹ ˈboʊθ weɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這個共乘是單向的，還是去回都算？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both ways, morning and afternoon, all week.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ weɪz ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ænd ˈæftɚˌnun ɔl wik/
dialogue.zh: 都共乘，早上和下午，整個星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, that's a big change for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɡɑɾ ˈɪt ðæts ə ˈbɪɡ tʃeɪndʒ fɚ ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 了解，對我們來說是很大的改變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It really is, my mornings already feel calmer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈɹiəli ɪz maɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋz ɔlˈɛdi fil ˈkɑlmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 真的是，我早上的時間已經從容多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leo seems excited to ride with Mia.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlioʊ simz ɪkˈsaɪɾɪd tə ɹaɪd wɪð ˈmiə/
dialogue.zh: 里歐看起來很期待跟米雅一起坐車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mia too, she talks about it at breakfast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmiə tu ʃi tɔks əˈbaʊt ɪt æt ˈbɹɛkfəst/
dialogue.zh: 米雅也是，她早餐時一直說這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, this was a good pickup line chat.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðɪs wəz ə ɡʊd ˈpɪkˌʌp laɪn tʃæt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這趟接送線上的閒聊真不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, best one I've had all week, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ bɛst wʌn aɪv hæd ɔl wik ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 哈，說實話這是這週我最開心的一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll see you next Monday at three fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl si ju nɛkst ˈmʌnˌdeɪ æt θɹi ˈfɪftɪn/
dialogue.zh: 下週一三點十五見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You will, I'll wave so you spot me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl aɪl ˈweɪv soʊ ju ˈspɑt mi/
dialogue.zh: 會的，到時我揮手跟你打招呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal. Thanks for asking, Dana.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil θæŋks fɚ ˈæskɪŋ ˈdanə/
dialogue.zh: 說定。謝謝你開口問，黛娜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, Marcus, see you Monday!
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ˈmɑɹkəs si ju ˈmʌnˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 該說謝謝的是你，馬克斯，週一見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive safe, see you at the front gate!
dialogue.phonetic: /dɹaɪv ˈseɪf si ju æt ðə fɹʌnt ˈɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 路上小心，我們在大門口見！

script.youtube_title: 【相約學校共乘接送🚗】「接送隊伍每天都可怕」輪流開車、油錢分攤與延遲規則🧾🎧｜聽完就能約共乘｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Organizing a School Carpool
script.youtube_title_en: "The Pickup Line Is Brutal" — Organizing a School Carpool
script.youtube_description:
「接送隊伍每天都可怕」——在放學後的校門口，兩位家長怎麼約成一星期共乘輪流接送？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在車陣打轉的學校門口。

你會聽到：提議共乘、輪流分日子、確認接孩子的時間；安全座椅要不要帶、油錢怎麼每週分攤；延遲幾分鐘的寬限規則、超過要提前打電話；還有生病或出城時的備援駕駛、叫網約車的緊急對策。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與日常短句，反覆出現的是美國家長真實的語感：um、well、so、ha、honestly。聽完你就會用：Would you ever、how would we split、What if、that's all、Deal。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The pickup line is brutal" — how do two parents set up a weekly carpool right at the school gate? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in the circling after-school traffic.

You will hear: proposing a carpool, splitting the days and confirming pickup times, whether car seats are needed, dividing gas money every Sunday, a grace window for being late, calling ahead if it runs long, backup drivers for sickness, and a rideshare only for emergencies.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk parents really use: um, well, so, ha, honestly. By the end you'll own phrases like Would you ever, how would we split, What if, and Deal.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧共乘接送英文｜輪流分日・油錢分攤・延遲寬限｜生病時的備援駕駛怎麼約｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
每天放學，校門口的車陣繞個不停，兩位家長怎麼把接送變成一週輪流共乘？油錢該怎麼分？有人遲到了要等多久？臨時生病又有誰能代開？

這一集帶大家走進放學後的校門口，從提議共乘、分日子、確認接小孩時間，一路聽到安全座椅、油錢分攤、延遲規則、備援駕駛與緊急叫車，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🚗 提議句：Would you ever want to share a carpool?
🗓️ 分工日：I was thinking I take Monday and Tuesday.
💵 油錢句：Now the awkward part, gas money.
⏰ 寬限句：We need a grace window, um, ten minutes.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，讓 well、um、honestly 這些小詞自然地接進句子裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這兩位家長在門口聊一次，下次自己約共乘，話就從嘴邊自己冒出來。

祝你家的接送早晨從此輕鬆一點。
